description: GISMap agent recipes. Each step names its interface: declarative URL, standalone JavaScript, in-browser API (globalThis.gisMapOnline) or an outside tool. None is a hosted REST endpoint.

recipes.title: Interactive map with filtering, symbology and sharing
recipes.question: Can an AI agent turn a public dataset into a filtered, styled map I can share?
triggers: Map this data and color it by population
Filter these counties and make a choropleth I can share
Make one map colored by year and another by acreage, and give me two links

recipes.title: Interactive geographic briefing
recipes.question: Can an AI agent build a slide briefing with one map slide per area and context from another layer?
triggers: Create slides about these districts
Build an interactive crime briefing for Philadelphia
Make a presentation with one slide per county

recipes.title: Guided geographic tour
recipes.question: Can an AI agent create a guided map tour of places in a set order?
triggers: Create a tour of San Francisco landmarks
Show me these locations in sequence
Fly between these places with a caption at each

recipes.title: Location-based field tasks
recipes.question: Can an AI agent create a field inspection checklist for a place that someone can open on their phone?
triggers: Make a field inspection checklist for this park
Create five tasks to do on site at this address
Send someone to check these locations

recipes.title: Numeric or fixed-height 3D extrusion
recipes.question: Can an AI agent make a 3D map where each area's height shows a number?
triggers: Make a 3D map of grape production in California
Make the county heights represent acreage
Extrude these buildings by height

recipes.title: 3D spatial chart (strata, footprint stacks)
recipes.question: Can an AI agent separate overlapping events by year in 3D?
triggers: Separate overlapping fire perimeters by year
Stack these events in 3D by year
Make a five-part 3D brief of fire history

recipes.title: LiDAR point clouds and 3D models (utility and vegetation data)
recipes.question: Can an AI agent put a LiDAR point cloud or a CAD model on a shareable 3D map?
triggers: Show this LiDAR LAZ file on a map
Show only vegetation and conductor wires from this point cloud
Place this glTF transmission tower model at these coordinates
Put the CAD model of this substation on the map in 3D

recipes.title: Vibe-matched map and presentation skin
recipes.question: Can an AI agent make a map whose look matches the subject, like a Halloween map of California colleges?
triggers: Make the map feel like Halloween in California
Theme this map in team colors
Give this forest map an autumn look
